'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Josh Mack LS Communing''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Josh Mack]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''Speeder Bowl XL'''. L1 Tatooine: Slave Quarters (sheet Slave Q); start is [[Communing]] at L2 (not V). L4 Maneuvering Flaps & Nick Of Time (sheet Man Flaps & Nick of Time; not V). L26 Antilles Maneuver & Rebel Reinforcements (V) (sheet Antilles Maneuver Combo). L35 Rogue 4 (digit cramped). L38 Rebel Gunrunner as written (not V). L40 Strikeforce (V) (sheet Strike Force). L49–50 Let's Go Left dittos are not (V). L53 Talon Karrde (sheet subtitle uncertain). Only defensive-shield line 9 is inked (Let's Keep A Little Optimism Here); the other shield lines are blank or too faint to read on the Xerox.
